messages:
Ivy: Quick microcopy QA: top-nav shows `Open Console — Ctrl+K`. We need Mac shortcut too but keep compact. Options?

Sam: `Open Console (Ctrl/Cmd+K)` is short and familiar.

Priya: Works visually but on small widths the parent truncates trailing text. We should avoid relying on inline shortcuts.

DevOps: We render shortcut span separately so we can hide it and put combo in tooltip. SRs need a full sentence though.

Ivy: Proposal: visible `Open Console` only. Tooltip: `Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K`. Add a sr-only description: `Press Control or Command and K to open the Console`.

Sam: Agree. Use spaces around + for readability: `Ctrl/Cmd + K`.

Priya: For localization, full words in aria help translators. So ARIA uses `Control`/`Command`, visuals keep `Ctrl`/`Cmd`.

a11y-bot: Recommend `aria-describedby` to point at a hidden element with the expanded sentence. Ensure focus styles and role=button present.

DevOps: If we ever support custom shortcuts, tooltip could be dynamic. For now keep static `Shortcut:` label so it doesn't imply configurability.

Ivy: Final strings: Tooltip: `Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K`. SR text: `Press Control or Command and K to open the Console`. I'll update Figma and the component README with an example.

Sam: Approved. Please paste the PR link after you push.

Ivy: Will do — thanks!
